extraction_scope: Worker-6 final mechanism ontology bounded to source-supported RF3 antifungal mechanism assays; no figure-only exact quantitative values are invented.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RF3 has source-supported time-kill activity against Candida albicans at MIC-scaled concentrations.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This supports fungicidal kinetics, not a specific molecular binding target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RF3 depolarizes the Candida albicans cytoplasmic membrane in a concentration-dependent membrane-potential assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The claim is limited to membrane depolarization under the tested assay conditions.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RF3 increases Candida albicans membrane permeability in a propidium iodide flow-cytometry assay.
direct_assay_types: propidium iodide membrane permeabilization flow cytometry
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure-level fluorescence percentages are not converted into exact table values.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RF3-treated Candida albicans shows membrane surface and ultrastructural damage by SEM/TEM.

source_locator.locator: xml:fig=8;xml:sec=Scanning Electron Microscopy and Transmission Electron Microscopy

mechanism_claims.limitations: Morphology supports membrane disruption but not a unique molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: RF3 induces intracellular ROS formation in Candida albicans in a DCFH-DA assay.
mechanism_claims.limitations: ROS induction is reported as part of the dual membrane/ROS mechanism; downstream pathway specificity is not established.
